title: First-stage landing | Onboard camera
summary: Sped-up onboard camera footage of the Falcon 9 first stage landing on a drone ship during the THAICOM 8 mission on May 27, 2016. It shows the descent from grid fin deployment to touchdown.
why: HN links it in SpaceX landing threads as the best first-person view of how hard a booster landing is.

quote.text: The landing video from the rocket[0] really puts into perspective how much this truly is 'rocket science'.
